title: Leo's Sixth Try
body: On Saturday morning, Emma and her brother Leo went to the sports center near their home. They wanted to play basketball, but Leo was worried because he could not throw the ball very well. Emma put a small bag on the floor to show him where to stand. First, they practiced short passes, and then Leo tried to throw the ball into the basket. He missed five times, but Emma smiled and told him to try again. On his sixth try, the ball went through the basket. Leo jumped and shouted with joy. They played for another twenty minutes before taking a break to drink some water.
